label: Žinčica
note: The Slovak name for the same whey drink, made from the whey left over from bryndza.

about.text: Žinčica, Žinčice, Żętyca, Жентиця, or Zyntyca, Jintiță is a drink made of sheep milk whey similar to kefir consumed mostly in Slovakia and Poland. It is a by-product in the process of making bryndza cheese.
